acceptance: One detached Harbor projection derives from one validated Planning v2 revision and one closed execution snapshot after all five digests are recomputed.
Every runtime fact binds one execution revision, evidence-set digest and policy digest; snapshot splicing fails closed.
Projection exposes at most one dependency-proven unblocked frontier and one current user question; contradictory truth fails closed.

RAPTOR, GraphRAG, Memory and other advisory context may add bounded reference-only not-verified metadata but can never change the goal, dependency graph, frontier, gate, claim, receipt, decision or owner-question truth.
The content-free read-only result cannot mutate authority, state, files, providers, UI, hosts or live systems.
The exact two-path candidate passes tests-first, focused, dependency, static and all three central lanes on one frozen blob pair, followed by fresh independent hostile QA and Root/Sol deep review.
baseline_readback: both paths absent in HEAD, index and worktree

control_plane.next_action: independent review, then serialized Root registration after exact compare-before

forbidden: A third writer path, shared-source edit, router edit, evidence edit by the product writer, schema migration, persistence, shadow state, cache or new authority store.

Trusting next_runnable_slices[0], roadmap prose, GraphRAG, RAPTOR, Memory, model output or caller ordering without recomputing the canonical dependency frontier from the validated Planning revision and revision-bound facts.
Creating, acquiring, renewing, releasing or transferring a claim or lease; closing a gate; recording an owner decision; dispatching, starting, pausing, cancelling or resuming an agent or worker.

Raw Planning text, objective text, clarification text, receipt body, source content, prompt, reasoning, log, exception text, private path, credential, provider response or unbounded advisory data in the public projection or error.
UI, route, plugin, provider, network, process, thread, filesystem, Git, worktree, commit, push, deploy, host, notification or other live effect.
hostile_matrix: Stale Planning revision, stale content hash, wrong definition/overlay/evidence/policy/composite digest, cross-revision fact, duplicate node, duplicate fact, contradictory completion, missing dependency and cyclic dependency all fail closed before a frontier is returned.
Claims and open gates from execution revision N spliced with completions, receipts or decisions from N+1 fail composite and per-fact binding even when the caller relabels the outer snapshot N+1.
A later dependent slice such as H1-31 cannot be projected while H1-29 remains unresolved even if stale prose or an advisory next-runnable list names H1-31 first.
node.gate_ids and inverted gate.blocks must be exact reciprocal pairs; either mismatch rejects before digest, completion or frontier evaluation.
A ready node with an unresolved gate or active claim is not frontier-ready; completion plus active claim is contradictory.

Zero ready nodes returns a bounded no-frontier projection; one or several unclaimed, unblocked ready nodes produce exactly the lexicographically first node plus only an additional-ready count, never an unordered or caller-selected result.

Zero current user-owned questions returns null; exactly one open required user clarification or open user-owned Planning gate returns one bounded reference; multiple current user-owned questions fail closed as ambiguous. Reviewer and machine gates never become owner questions.

Canonical claim, gate, clarification, receipt and owner-decision facts must bind the same Planning revision and known node or gate identity; stale, orphaned, conflicting or duplicate identities fail closed.
Graph, Memory, RAPTOR and GraphRAG objects with hostile iteration, equality, truth, repr or mapping callbacks are never evaluated as authority and cannot alter any truth field.

Every input and output uses exact built-in containers and scalars; subclasses, bool-as-int, iterators, generators, mutable aliases, unknown keys, over-budget collections and noncanonical identifiers reject.
Mutating every caller input and returned nested container after the call cannot alter any later projection; repeated failures are fresh code-only errors with cause and context absent.
Construction and projection invoke no external or callback effect.

canonical_digest.algorithm: SHA-256(domain UTF-8 || NUL || u64be(payload byte length) || canonical payload bytes)
canonical_digest.canonical_json: Exact built-in JSON values only; recursively sorted string keys by Unicode scalar order, compact separators, ensure_ascii=true with lowercase escapes, allow_nan=false, UTF-8, no duplicate keys or subclasses.
canonical_digest.evidence_set_rule: evidence_digests is the sorted unique exact tuple of every fact evidence_digest; hash the literal payload schema odysseus.harbor.execution_evidence_set.v1.
canonical_digest.overlay_rule: Use literal schema odysseus.harbor.execution_overlay.v1 and exact closed fact tuples, each sorted by its primary ID before hashing.

canonical_input.advisory_refs: exact built-in tuple of 0..64 exact reference records; never consulted for truth
canonical_input.external_trust_roots: expected_roadmap_content_hash and expected_composite_snapshot_digest are mandatory exact digest strings supplied from already accepted Planning/execution authority outside planning_document and execution_snapshot; both must equal independently recomputed values before any projection fact is used
canonical_input.planning_document: exact built-in dict accepted by validate_planning_definition
canonical_input.roadmap_selection: execution_snapshot project_id, roadmap_id, roadmap_revision and roadmap_content_hash must select exactly one revision_state=approved roadmap and match project.latest_approved_revision exactly

container_and_scalar_contract.containers: Every object is exact built-in dict with exact keys; every ordered collection is exact built-in tuple; list, mapping, sequence, iterator, generator and subclasses reject. Returned values are frozen/detached.
container_and_scalar_contract.decision_ref: exact None or exact identifier string equal to the sole matching owner_decision.decision_id
container_and_scalar_contract.execution_revision: type(value) is int, 1 <= value <= 9223372036854775807; bool and subclasses reject
container_and_scalar_contract.planning_document_budget: definition_bytes_max applies to the canonical_json encoding named in canonical_digest, not caller serialization

error_contract.freshness: Capture only an allowlisted code inside the caught Exception frame; after that frame returns, raise a new HarborPlanningProjectionError(code) from None. args contains only code; cause and context are None.

implementation_contract.fact_binding: Every fact execution_revision equals the outer execution_revision; every fact evidence_digest is included in the recomputed evidence set; every fact evidence_set_digest equals the outer recomputed evidence_set_digest; every fact policy_digest equals the outer recomputed fixed policy digest. Primary IDs are exact unique strings and all referenced slice/gate identities exist in the selected Planning revision.

output.shape: frozen slots dataclass with recursively detached immutable tuples and frozen reference values; repr is content-free

projection_mapping.claim_refs: Every active_claim exactly once, sorted by claim_id, as kind=claim; duplicates already reject.
projection_mapping.clarification_refs: Every clarification exactly once, sorted by clarification_id, as kind=clarification.
projection_mapping.decision_refs: Every owner_decision exactly once, sorted by decision_id, as kind=decision.
projection_mapping.frontier: Null or kind=slice for the first lexicographically sorted unblocked ready node; additional_ready_count is the remaining candidate count.
projection_mapping.gate_refs: Every declared Planning gate exactly once, sorted by gate_id, as kind=gate.
projection_mapping.not_verified_refs: Sorted unique refs for failed/not_verified receipts, deferred/expired gates, deferred clarifications and every advisory_ref. Advisory refs appear nowhere else.
projection_mapping.owner_question: Null or the sole kind=gate or kind=clarification current user-owned candidate; never machine/reviewer/advisory.
projection_mapping.receipt_refs: Every verification_receipt exactly once, sorted by receipt_id, as kind=receipt.
projection_mapping.tuple_rule: All public tuples are deduplicated by exact (kind,ref_id), sorted by kind then ref_id and frozen. Any duplicate fact identity rejects before mapping.

public_api: build_harbor_planning_projection(*, planning_document: dict, execution_snapshot: dict, expected_roadmap_content_hash: str, expected_composite_snapshot_digest: str, advisory_refs: tuple = ()) -> HarborPlanningProjection
readiness_and_precedence: Dependency set is the exact union of node.depends_on and depends_on edges (from node to dependency). Compute sorted node_gate_pairs from node.gate_ids and sorted gate_block_pairs as inverted (node_id,gate_id) pairs from gate.blocks; require exact equality before definition digest or readiness. Unknowns, duplicates, cycles or asymmetric gate pairs are contradictory.

A node is dependency-ready only when every dependency has exactly one accepted completion record. Every accepted completion is valid only if all union dependencies were accepted, every gate blocking that node is satisfied, no required open or deferred clarification exists and no active claim exists for the node; otherwise contradictory_authority. A completed node is never ready.

Every declared Planning gate has exactly one gate_state whose owner_class equals the frozen gate-kind mapping. Missing, duplicate or extra gate states are contradictory. open, deferred and expired block every node named by gate.blocks; satisfied does not block.

Machine/reviewer gates always require decision_ref=None and zero owner decisions. User open requires either decision_ref=None with zero decisions or exactly one referenced changes_requested decision. User satisfied requires exactly one referenced accepted decision. User deferred requires exactly one referenced deferred decision. User expired requires decision_ref=None and zero decisions. Every other matrix cell, missing reference equality or extra decision is contradictory_authority.
Any running or paused claim excludes its slice from the frontier. Duplicate claims per slice, claim for an unknown slice or claim plus accepted completion is contradictory.

Required open clarification blocks its slice; resolved does not; deferred blocks without creating a current owner question. Nonrequired clarification never blocks. Duplicate clarification identity or unknown slice is contradictory.
Verification receipts never complete or unblock a node; they are content-free evidence refs only. failed or not_verified is added to not_verified_refs.

Frontier candidates are uncompleted nodes whose dependencies are complete, with no blocking gate, required open/deferred clarification or active claim. Sort by node_id Unicode code-point order; expose first or null plus additional_ready_count.

Owner-question candidates are only open user-owned Planning gates and required open clarifications. Sort is forbidden as conflict resolution: zero yields null, one yields its exact bounded reference, more than one raises ambiguous_owner_question. Machine/reviewer gates are blockers only.

reference_shape.rule: Every public reference is one frozen bounded exact-kind/exact-identifier value; no text, path, content or raw payload crosses the boundary. goal_ref is exactly kind=roadmap and ref_id=the selected roadmap_id.

registration_preconditions: Independent review re-derives DAG, schemas, digests, errors, no-authority flags, baselines and all raw no-filter pins.

Compare-before rechecks Open Work/Round7 but excludes those self-mutating routers from claim pins; unchanged Round6/Guidance remain raw no-filter pins. Require zero claims/leases, absent writers and zero collision/drift.
Root creates one claim-bound Evidence receipt and atomically registers only the two paths, exact commands and one lease; all three central validators pass before test edit.
This packet grants no registration, implementation, commit, push, deploy or live authority.
stop_rule: Stop before registration on authority, dependency, packet, pin, baseline, path, node, command, worktree or collision drift. Stop the writer on a third path, shadow state, caller-selected truth, stale or advisory authority, raw/private output, public exception context, schema/API expansion or any external effect. Permit one correction only in the named DAG-and-authority class; recurrence releases blocked and requires materially fresh Root/Sol architecture.

supersedes_unregistered_review_failure.reason: Unregistered v1-v2 lacked closed snapshot trust; v3 omitted reciprocal node-gate binding.

Run exact eight, full focused, dependency, static and all three central lanes.
